historical_record.description: Sutro Tower, begun in 1971, made its first transmissions.
The Board of Permit Appeals upheld the granting of a demolition permit for the structure at 250 Palo Alto Avenue, over the protest of the appellant. The present building dates from 1974.
On discretionary review, the City Planning Commission approved, 4-0, strengthening Sutro Tower to bring it up to current seismic safety standards.

The City Planning Commission certified, 5-2, the final environmental impact report for a 125-foot beam of digital television antennas on the east face of Sutro Tower, about 630 to 755 feet up the roughly 975-foot tower (Motion 14552). On discretionary review, the City Planning Commission approved, 7-0, the digital television antenna support column on Sutro Tower, on conditions including an independent engineering review and a special inspector on site throughout its erection.

On discretionary review, the City Planning Commission declined, 4-0, to intervene, and approved three concrete pads outside the Sutro Tower building and two rooftop enclosures for broadcasting equipment.
The City Planning Commission took no discretionary review of the proposal to relocate and replace two FM radio antennae and replace one television antenna at the existing broadcast facility, 6-0.
An existing broadcast facility, Sutro Tower, stood on the lot.

The City Planning Commission took no discretionary review of the proposal to install supports for digital television transmission lines on the roof of the equipment building at the existing broadcast facility, 6-0.

The City Planning Commission took no discretionary review of the proposal to install digital television equipment inside tenant transmitter rooms, on the roof and on existing concrete pads at the Sutro Tower site, 6-0.

The City Planning Commission took discretionary review and approved as amended the retroactive permitting of 176 antennas and two underground fuel tanks at the existing Sutro Tower broadcast facility, 7-0.

The City Planning Commission took discretionary review and approved as amended two microwave interconnect antennas, two dish antennas and one whip antenna at the existing Sutro Tower broadcast facility, 7-0.
The City Planning Commission took discretionary review and approved as amended a concrete pad to even out the floor in the transmitter building at the existing Sutro Tower broadcast facility, 7-0.
The City Planning Commission took discretionary review and approved as amended twenty-four wireless data-service internet-access panel antennas at the existing Sutro Tower broadcast facility, 7-0.
The City Planning Commission took discretionary review and approved as amended one news-gathering antenna at the existing Sutro Tower broadcast facility, 7-0.

The City Planning Commission did not take discretionary review and approved the building permit, with the standard conditions for facilities on Sutro Tower, for three panel antennas and one GPS antenna, 6-1.
The City Planning Commission took discretionary review and approved the staff recommendations for the voluntary seismic retrofit of Sutro Tower.
The City Planning Commission took discretionary review and approved the installation of an emergency generator, an FM antenna and satellite dishes at Sutro Tower.
